evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.945 Torr at 99.7 sccm Ar, consistent with the preceding stable ramp baseline near 2.94 Torr.
Growth began at 2.938 Torr; subsequent readings rise persistently despite unchanged temperature and flow setpoints.
Pressure reached 3.208 Torr, about 9% above growth-start pressure, after successive increases.
Temperature 750.3 °C and Ar 100.1 sccm closely match setpoints; heater power is stable at 45.2%, leaving the pressure rise unexplained by these channels.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; no oxygen evidence is available to distinguish air ingress from restricted exhaust.
